parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: The calling vendor (G32). Ownership of the addressed resource is checked against it.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only purchase orders with `issuedAt` strictly after this instant.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Only purchase orders for this node.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token (`nextCursor` of the previous page). Repeat the filters on every page request. An undecodable cursor is `400 invalid-cursor`; an undeclared query parameter is `400 unknown-query-parameter`.
